title: Kaha Ghareeb ka ghar
body:
Fatima zehra, fatima zehra..(2)
ghum e hussain mein kaisa sharaf ye paaya hai ke apne haatho'n se maine alam sajaya hai
suna hai aati hai majlis mein fatima zehra
ye baat soch ke farsh e azaa bichaya hai
<<MINI>>
karam ye majlis e shabbir ne kiya warna
kaha'n ghareeb ka ghar, aur kaha'n hussain ki maa..(2)
karam ye majlis e shabbir ne kiya warna
kaha'n ghareeb ka ghar, aur kaha'n hussain ki maa..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khabar hai binte rasool e khuda ke aane ki
badal rahi hai hawaein ghareeb khane ki..(2)
mera naseeb ke mehmaa'n hui meri zehra
<<MINI>>
kaha'n ghareeb ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Farishte, shaah, gadagar sabhi hai peshe nazar
hai ambiya ki qatarein lagi mere ghar par..(2)
tumhare aane se bibi ye martaba paaya
<<MINI>>
kaha'n ghareeb ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye majlis e shabbir mein behte hue aasu
firdaus ke bagho'n mein saja deti hai zehra
shehzadi zamee'n par ise girne nahi deti
bach jaye to kausar mein mila deti hai zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ye nauha khwani ye soz o salam aur matam
hamare ashk hai bibi ke zakhm ka marham..(2)
agar na hote wasila ye matam o nauha
<<MINI>>
kaha'n ghareeb ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghareeb khane ko jannat bana diya bibi
khushi ye aisi hai jisne rula diya bibi..(2)
har ek ashk ne aankho se girte girte kaha
<<MINI>>
kaha'n ghareeb ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sare hussain jo sheeree ke ghar mein aaya tha
sare hussain ke hamraah aayi thi zehra..(2)
jo dekha bibi ko sheeree ne ye kiya nauha
<<MINI>>
kaha'n ghareeb ka ghar...
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye..
Jab kisi ghar mein koi mar jaye... mar jaye
duniya ghum baatne ko aati hai... aati hai
haye kitni ghareeb hai zehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
pursa lene bhi chal ke aati hai
ya hussain, ya hussain..(2)
Ghar mein mere majlis hui aur bich gaya farsh e aza
zakir ne jab majlis padhi aur haal rukhsat ka jo padha
<<MINI>>
itna roi zehra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Farhan aur mazhar padha, nauha shahe mazloom ka
tha zikr jab ashoor ka, shabbir par khanjar chala
<<MINI>>
itna roi zehra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Dete rahe ehle azaa
ghazi ka pursa, sarwar ka pursa
akbar ka qasim ka asghar ka pursa
<<MINI>>
itna roi zehra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ka kulsum o fizza ka pursa
sajjad bali sakina ka pursa
<<MINI>>
itna roi zehra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Baali ka pursa, chadar ka pursa
aun o mohammad ka baqer ka pursa
<<MINI>>
itna roi zehra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Naizo pe rakhe har ek sar ka pursa
bibi tumhare har ek ghar ka pursa
<<MINI>>
itna roi zehra..(2)
